answer.rationale: The primary contract lapses in 14 days with no auto-renew, so deferral risks a gap on a 94% line with no buffer. A primary switch would meet the 18% mandate on unit price but would raise cutover/delivery risk, which the objective forbids. Inherited patterns favor incumbent continuity for integration and deliveries (c1) and using a market benchmark at renewal to move price and terms (c4). Intend to negotiate against the low-cost quote rather than switch or add a source that does not replace the expiring primary. Verifying c2 and c4 because those records may be from other categories and are the load-bearing claims on challenger onboarding and achievable incumbent concessions. Uncertain whether the incumbent can actually deliver 18% without a risky cutover.
